text_block_list.text:
The fruits of summer training camp were 
already visible in Satono Crown's 
physique.

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Quite impressive. Hmm... The 
musculature around your hips is remarkably 
solid too...

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
Milady. Touching around here doesn't hurt, 
does it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm completely fine.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for making a house call.

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. More importantly, to see 
such improvement in barely three months 
since the Derby is truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Impressive, right? That's my Trainer for 
you. Whenever an issue comes up, they fix 
it right away."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"And I won't make the same mistake again. 
I'll make sure to visit once a month. 
Whenever my schedule clears up, it'll be 
my top priority."

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In that case, there shouldn't be any 
problem. I don't believe there are any 
special precautions needed for training or 
races.

text_block_list.name: Chiropractor
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, then~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...And on that note, shall we start 
getting ready to head home too?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow is the last day of the training 
camp, so today, without doing any 
training—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kura-chaaan! Have you seen Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan? No, at least she wasn't around 
the entrance.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I seeee... So did she head down to the 
beach, then?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Shall I help you search for 
it too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm okay! I just wanted to invite 
them to train. I'll look for them myself!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, and one more thing, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will be graduating from my position as 
sub-trainer this summer. Thank you so very 
much for everything.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...! Right, Dia's debut date has been 
decided too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So from now on, I will focus on 
training for my own sake.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Holding close to heart what the two of you 
taught me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Nothing stays the same forever, does 
it? Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Spring ended, and summer ended too. Up 
next is the GⅠ season of autumn.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if another big change is about 
to come.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown gazes up into the sky against 
the glare, predicting the future that lies 
ahead—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, excuse me!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I asked a senior in the Ritto Dorm! She 
said the two of you know some of the 
hardest training routines in the entire 
dorm!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So, I have a favor to ask! Please take me—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Won't you knock some sense back into me!?
